input.summary: Add Client ownership of Client Content, Client IP and Client data, assignment of Support Services work product, and licence-back of embedded TrueLink IP
input.comment: [Playbook] The ownership clause only confirms TrueLink's rights in the Interface, so we have added the corresponding Client side: we retain all rights in Client Content, Client Intellectual Property and our borrower/loan data, and we own the work product of the Support Services we pay for, with a licence back to any TrueLink IP embedded in it. This reflects our standard position that we own what we pay for and what we put in, and it does not affect TrueLink's ownership of the Interface or the Credit Data licence in Section 8(d).

ops.oldText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
ops.newText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface. Except for the license granted in Section 8(d), as between the parties Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client's Intellectual Property and all data provided by or on behalf of Client or generated through Client's use of the Interface (including borrower and loan data), and nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns any ownership of the foregoing to TrueLink. TrueLink hereby assigns to Client all right, title and interest in all results, work product and deliverables of the Support Services created for Client, and to the extent any TrueLink Intellectual Property is embedded therein, TrueLink grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense such TrueLink Intellectual Property as part of such results. No joint ownership of any intellectual property is created by this Agreement.
